summary: Google DeepMind describes its internal 'AI Control Roadmap' framework for monitoring and constraining potentially misaligned AI agents deployed within Google, and publishes a companion policy paper for policymakers.

practices.reason: The roadmap's threat-modelling framework and monitoring metrics (coverage, recall, time-to-response) describe a transferable method for measuring and trusting agentic systems, though it is presented as Google's internal process rather than a released tool.
practices.quote: we constantly measure performance across three critical metrics: coverage (the fraction of traffic monitored), recall (the fraction of misaligned behaviors caught), and time-to-response.

practices.reason: The internal asynchronous monitoring prototype for coding agent trajectories is a lab-internal safety process, informative but not directly reproducible by outside teams.
practices.quote: Our team has built an internal prototype of an asynchronous monitoring system that reviews coding agent trajectories, and escalates findings for human review.
